description: Remove an accepted member from an endpoint you own: the membership row is deleted, their endpoint-scoped credentials are revoked, and their reads stop answering. Captures they already signed keep their attribution. Inputs: membershipId from list_members, and endpointId. Confirm with your user first, naming the participant back to them; re-inviting later takes a fresh invite.

endpointId.description: Opaque id from a prior list_* call, verbatim.

name: revoke_member
title: Revoke member
